questions.explanation: Newton's First Law of Motion, also known as the law of inertia, describes the behavior of objects at rest or in uniform motion.
questions.question: What is the principle that states an object in motion stays in motion with the same speed and in the same direction unless acted upon by an unbalanced force?

questions.explanation: Kinetic energy is the energy of motion. It depends on the object's mass and velocity.
questions.question: What is the energy an object possesses due to its motion?

questions.explanation: Momentum is a vector quantity defined as mass in motion, calculated by multiplying an object's mass by its velocity (p = mv).
questions.question: What is the measure of the amount of motion an object has, calculated as the product of its mass and velocity?
